name: 2007 (2013 Games)

origin.summary: An event from the 2013 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A 1000m row followed by five rounds of pull-ups and push jerks — a near-identical repeat of the 2007 Games' Hopper Workout, referencing that inaugural year directly in its name.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2013/1 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; the original event this workout is named for; later revisited as "2007 Reload" at the 2020 Games
